title.narrative: Support to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in the Digitalization of the Visa Issuance System

description.narrative: UNDP will provide targeted support to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in advancing the digitalization of its visa issuance system, in line with the technical and procedural requirements emerging from Montenegro’s EU accession process. Through this engagement, UNDP will assist the Ministry in modernizing visa-related procedures, strengthening institutional and technical capacities, and ensuring readiness for alignment with EU systems. This support will further consolidate the Ministry’s institutional ability to manage its expanded obligations under the Schengen acquis, while contributing to a more efficient, transparent, and citizen-oriented public administration.

condition.narrative: The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
